gen-nixie-one-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text keeps its terminals open and its manner contemporary, a sans-serif foil to the wiry, unthinning curves of Nixie One. Nixie One sets the retro mood; the body text does the talking.
gen-nixie-one-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Nixie One draws its retro-tech curves with a constant stroke and clear, open gaps. Zalando Sans Expanded spreads its sparse, wide-set letters out beside it, a clean and contemporary sans-serif.
gen-nixie-one-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpand: Nixie One draws plain, unshaded lines with a retro-tech hum. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded is the modern sans partner, with open-mouthed curves that give those bare lines something to lean on.
gen-nixie-one-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antique: Zen Kaku Gothic Antique reads smooth and modern, with no snags. Nixie One adds a nostalgic, retro-tech display heading in open curves, and this sans-serif body keeps the page grounded.
gen-nixie-one-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans feels technical yet approachable, giving each bowl a wide channel. IBM Plex Sans is the friendly counterweight to Nixie One, whose tubular, wire-like letterforms carry the retro mood.
gen-orbitron-fs-chillax: Minimal and precise, Orbitron spreads its letters far apart along the line and gives every e a large, clear eye. Chillax loosens things up, its spaghetti-like lines leaving loops pleasantly unfinished.
gen-orbitron-gf-fragment-mono: Minimal, precise, widely spaced: that is Orbitron up top. Fragment Mono, a monospace body, lines its letters up like nails on a ruler, giving the heading's open apertures a tidy, structured companion.
gen-orbitron-gf-martian-mono: Technical from the first glance, Orbitron spreads its open, readable letters far apart while Martian Mono sets fixed-width, code-style type below. Next to each other they feel structured and generously spaced.
gen-orbitron-source-serif-4: Source Serif 4 is a dignified serif with a gaping c opening. Its stroke tightens only slightly at curve tops, so paragraphs under the Orbitron heading read steadily, with weight changes that never turn dramatic.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-amulya: Amulya keeps its curves generously open and thoroughly contemporary. Press Start 2P brings the fun, retro punch with letters pinned far apart, while Amulya does the quieter job of carrying the words.
